_about: New sections for the fact courses. Each section becomes ONE lesson of 6 sourced facts. `sources` are Wikipedia article titles (en), https URLs, or bible:<passage> (World English Bible via bible-api.com). `angle` steers the extractor. Wave 1.

earth.name: Deserts & Dunes
earth.angle: what a desert is, how hot or cold, dunes, the biggest deserts, how little rain falls

earth.name: Mountains
earth.angle: heights, the tallest peaks, ranges, how climbers deal with thin air

earth.name: Islands & Reefs
earth.angle: biggest islands, reefs, what lives in a reef, island chains

earth.name: Lightning & Thunder
earth.angle: how hot, how fast, how far thunder carries, how many strikes, staying safe
